parent_objective: design no-rollout materialization of offtrack-support repair candidates into executable task specs
blocked_by: candidate materialization rules must be frozen before implementation
supersedes: ad hoc candidate materialization without explicit delta and validation rules

public_gates: M2193 must design candidate materialization from M2190 config and M2151 executable specs
M2193 must define delta application and fail-closed validation rules
M2193 must define output artifacts and metadata required for reset validation
M2193 must not implement materialization, reset environments, run measured execution, or rank profiles
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes no-rollout materialization rules for the audited repair candidate artifact
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: materialization design only; no implementation reset rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate deltas cannot be mapped to executable task specs
stop if materialization would require actor input changes
stop if output validation rules are ambiguous
stop if design would rank profiles before repaired execution
fallback_plan: route to candidate config repair if deltas are not materializable
route to implementation if design is complete and fail-closed
route to branch synthesis if materialization cannot change evidence

admission_evidence: M2190 candidate IDs and quotas are clean
M2151 executable specs are the current materialization base
allowed_updates: M2193 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for implementation if design passes
next_stage_criteria: validation and fail-closed behavior are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2193 designs task materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2193.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization cannot preserve history/task-family metadata, repair the design before implementation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares the audited candidate panel to become executable task data
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit no-rollout implementation but cannot compare profiles
must_synthesize_if: M2193 would run reset or rollout

hypothesis: The audited M2190 candidate artifact can be converted into a fail-closed no-rollout materialization design without actor-input or ranking shortcuts.
success_criteria: input and output artifacts are specified
validation and fail-closed rules are specified
no implementation reset rollout training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
decision_rule: M2193 passes if it freezes a complete no-rollout materialization design and pre-registers implementation without reset, rollout, or ranking.
